items.summary: Fix Market Intel access gating so that AI Sentiment content is always visible without any unlock, while Market Intelligence signals + market data remain fully hidden and do not fetch/compute until the user successfully unlocks with the passcode. Keep both AI Sentiment and the gated signals inside the same Market Intel page/section.

Correct backend Market Intel unlock semantics to be per-user and consistent with the frontend: (1) unlock must require the passcode every time, (2) lock must require the passcode, (3) checkMarketIntelAccess must reflect the user's current unlocked state (not merely that a principal once unlocked), and (4) remove any global shared unlock flag behavior that allows one user's action to affect another user.

Update the Market Intel frontend lock/unlock flow to match the required behavior: show AI Sentiment regardless of lock state; show a gated 'Signals Locked' panel with passcode input when locked; add a manual 'Lock Market Intel' control when unlocked that requires passcode confirmation; on lock, clear selected asset/timeframe state and clear cached Market Intel/Binary query data so signals cannot remain visible from cache.

Remove the Live Price and Advanced Analytics pages/sections from the app: delete their routes from the router, remove their navigation entries from BottomNav, and ensure there are no dead links to /live-price or /advanced-analytics anywhere in the UI.

Fix and modernize the visual design consistency (theme, spacing, typography, contrast/readability) for these sections/pages: Insights, Testimonials, Security, Highlights, and Ecosystem. Ensure they all match a single coherent site theme and are visually consistent with each other and with the rest of the site.

Add more noticeable motion design across the site (parallax/ambient movement, stronger section reveal animations, and smoky left-to-right/right-to-left transitions) while keeping content readable and not harming usability.

Expand the Whitepaper content by increasing length/coverage: add additional chapters and/or deepen existing chapters with more structured subsections, ensuring the chapter navigation remains accurate and scroll-based active tracking still works correctly.
Add more FAQ questions (with expandable answers) and ensure the FAQ styling remains consistent with the unified theme and improved readability.

Add new non-aura sections/features (implementer-chosen) that strengthen the site as a professional, real-time oriented platform, and integrate them into navigation and the unified theme. These additions must not reintroduce Live Price or Advanced Analytics as separate pages.
